browser: Codex In-app Browser (Chromium) with direct QA injection

runtimeValidation.method: The stable 2.13.7 artifact and both SHA-256-pinned startup files were fetched from the new production origin, combined by qa:prepare, and injected into a real Luogu tab; the runtime identity and public SPA routes were then exercised in the browser main world

startupMeasurement.method: Measured synchronous execution of the prepared 2.13.7 QA payload in the browser main world on P1001
startupMeasurement.purpose: Bootstrap execution budget; network integrity and delivery were independently verified by the production CDN gate

console.summary: No LuoguSP, Luogu-site, luogusp.round1.cc, or browser-extension warning/error was observed on the exercised routes.

limitations: The in-app browser does not install Tampermonkey; qa:prepare fetched the exact two pinned production startup files and the stable artifact was temporarily injected after the initial document load, so document-start restricted-page coverage was not repeated.
The browser session was not signed in, so IDE batch execution and private-message Ctrl+Click were not available.
Restricted article and paste recovery were not repeated in this domain-only hosting migration; their behavior remains covered by the passing automated suite and the previous stable browser run.
